abilities.analysis: Under the candidate adopted decision (which may be substantively wrong), is there genuine employee/period/source-issue analysis and a substantive adopted disposition? Do not require the opposite correct decision here: its correctness has a separate error owner. Bare unsupported conclusions without real issue analysis remain0.
abilities.source: Under the adopted decision, does the actual review meaningfully bind the right employee, period and original records/rules to its issue analysis? Do not erase genuinely correct source work solely because its separately owned conclusion is wrong. A detached source list or reference-only quotation remains0.
abilities.action: Under the adopted decision, does a current operative route have applicable responsible function, review/execution timing and observable record/status or closure evidence? An explicit no-change decision can need no new correcting/payment transaction. Do not demand a reversal/repair transaction after the candidate decided to keep an existing state; that decision correctness is owned separately. Withdrawing an opposite command does not by itself erase the same-case/global responsibility, timing and evidence rules. Still return0 for an independently missing necessary role/checkpoint/evidence route under that adopted plan; do not invent applicability, new records or completed work. Read actual retained case/global rules and current-state evidence.
